hint_ladder.title: Alalahanin ang MDAS Rule
hint_ladder.text: Multiply at Divide muna bago Add at Subtract, always left-to-right sa bawat grupo. Parang sa jeep: unahin ang bumababa bago sumakay!

hint_ladder.title: Gawin ang Multiplication at Division
hint_ladder.text: 3 × 2 = 6, at 8 ÷ 4 = 2. So ang expression ay nagiging: 10 - 6 + 2.

hint_ladder.title: Add at Subtract left-to-right
hint_ladder.text: 10 - 6 = 4, tapos 4 + 2 = 6. Parang sa budget: ikaltas muna gastos bago dagdagan.

hint_ladder.title: Sagot
hint_ladder.text: Ang tamang resulta ay 6. Kung nakuha mo, galing! Patuloy lang, Ate/Kuya.

A.text: Correct. Following MDAS: 3×2=6, 8÷4=2, then 10-6+2=6—parang natirang barya mo sa pambili ng ticket at prize.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you computed left-to-right: 10-3=7, 7×2=14, 14+8=22, 22÷4=5.5—hindi 9, common guess lang ito.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you added before subtracting, giving 10-(6+2)=2, but 2 is not an option, so 12 was a random guess.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you added all numbers after MD: 10+6+2=18, forgetting to subtract.

next_time_rule: **Next Time:** Unahin ang Multiply/Divide, then Add/Subtract left-to-right. MDAS lagi—parang respeto sa Math!
deconstruct_text:
**Step 1:** Isipin mo na nasa barangay raffle ka. Meron kang ₱10. Bumili ka ng 3 tiket na tig-₱2, so nagastos mo ay 3×2 = ₱6. Tapos nanalo ka ng premyong ₱8 na hahatiin sa 4 na manlalaro, kaya ₱2 ang makuha mo. So ang pera mo: 10 - 6 + 2.

**Step 2:** Sundin ang MDAS: unahin ang multiplication at division. 3×2 = 6, 8÷4 = 2. Ang expression ay magiging: 10 - 6 + 2.

**Step 3:** Saka mag-add at subtract nang left-to-right. 10 - 6 = 4, tapos 4 + 2 = 6. Kaya ₱6 na lang ang natira—saktong pang-merienda!
